dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, have you found the adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Not yet. No adeptus has come to give me back my axe, either. How strange...

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: I did in fact pick up a sword.

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: But... I don't know how to use swords! Did the adeptus get something wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Pan Guan'er
dialogues.text: Well, whatever. Why don't you take this sword with you? I still need to wait for my axe to come back...
